title: Ranking quantization certification and sanity checks for FP8/INT8 profiles
creator: Miguel Ortega
description: Establish a repeatable certification run and sanity-check suite for candidate FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles targeting the reranker model family. Aim: produce deterministic calibration runs, robust slice-aware NDCG/MRR comparisons, and clear gate decisions for promoting profiles into staging and production. This ticket covers test harness changes, a new small-sample acceptance checklist, and automation to upload artifacts to the eval bucket.
acceptance_criteria: Automated calibration workflow executes end-to-end for FP8/INT8 profiles without human intervention
Per-profile NDCG@10 and MRR deltas computed vs baseline and stored as CSV artifacts
Statistical significance test (paired bootstrap) implemented and produces pass/fail at configurable alpha
Holdback canary pipeline that runs on 10k real queries with slice annotations completes within 6 hours
Playbook entry created describing rollback criteria and emergency unpin steps
All artifacts linked in ticket and a single command reproduces the run locally (Dockerized)
calibration_workflow: Input: production-calib-set-v3 with randomized seed file
Step 1: FP8 per-layer scale search using 3 seed-only replicates
Step 2: INT8 symmetric per-channel quant sweep with 4 sample sizes [2k,5k,20k,50k]
Step 3: Collect layer activations and per-token KL/p99 drift metrics
Step 4: Produce binary profile artifact and human-readable summary JSON (for console import)
Step 5: Archive raw activations and profile to s3://redwood-evals/quant-cert/<run-id>/
eval_plan: Baseline: float32 model (pinned commit sha) evaluated on ranking-testset-v12
Metrics: NDCG@1, NDCG@3, NDCG@10, MRR, top-1 accuracy for rerank head
Stat test: paired bootstrap with 10k resamples, report median delta and 95% CI
Slice analysis: device type, user-query-length quartiles, session-priority tag
Report: artifact CSV and summary markdown uploaded to run folder and linked to ticket
gating_thresholds: Overall NDCG@10 delta must be >= -0.002 (i.e., loss <= 0.2% relative)
Per-slice worst-case NDCG@10 loss must be <= 0.005 for high-priority slices
MRR drop must not exceed 0.4% absolute on production traffic sample
Any candidate failing statistical significance at alpha=0.05 for key slices is rejected
Latency regression must be < 8ms P50 on dedicated GPU infra when compared to float baseline
results_summary: Run 2025-02-18: fp8-profile-A produced NDCG@10 delta -0.0009 vs baseline; passed overall gate
Run 2025-02-19: int8-profile-C produced NDCG@10 delta -0.0038; failed high-priority slice long_queries
FP8 candidate variability: seed-to-seed stddev on NDCG@10 = 0.0006 across 3 replicates
MRR changes tracked and annotated; none exceeded customer-impact thresholds for fp8-profile-A
Latency: fp8-profile-A P50 +3.4ms, int8-profile-C P50 +1.8ms (both within infra SLO)
